summary: Iteration 2 — tested the three new features end-to-end. Backend: 10/10 new-feature pytest cases pass (jobs/countries listing, country=India filter, alerts full CRUD + /summary + /new + /seen, duplicate rejection, MAX_ALERTS=10, ownership 404, interview/finish with 0 and >=1 answers, spoken_feedback present in evaluation). Frontend: country dropdown has 54 entries with counts and 'Remote / Anywhere' first (index 1 after default), selecting India filters 7,616 -> 399; URL params /jobs?country=India&work=Remote prefill both filters correctly; save-alert works; duplicate shows error toast 'You already have an alert for this search.'; alerts-bell in navbar links to /alerts; alert-view-all preserves filters in query string; alerts can be deleted. AI Interview setup shows iv-mode-voice and iv-mode-text cards; voice mode launches voice-interview UI with voice-question, voice-timer, iv-progress, voice-repeat-btn visible; typed answer via voice-answer-input + voice-submit-btn produces iv-evaluation; voice-stop-btn confirm → iv-report rendered with 'Recommendations' section. Text mode regression still works (iv-answer-input renders).

issues: When user clicks 'Alert me on new jobs' twice quickly, sonner stacks the earlier success toast with the new error toast — both visible together. Minor UX polish: dismiss prior toast or dedupe by id.

In headless Chromium webkitSpeechRecognition is actually injected so mic-warning did not show during testing. Verified fallback typed-answer path still works end-to-end regardless. Real STT could not be exercised (expected).

critical_code_review_comments: routes_alerts.list_alerts: runs 2*N count_documents() queries per request (one per alert for new_count + total). For a user at MAX_ALERTS=10 that's 20 Mongo counts per /api/alerts call; acceptable at MVP scale but adds latency and will scale poorly if alerts grow. Consider a single aggregation.

AlertsBell polls GET /api/alerts/summary every 60s per open tab; summary itself does N count_documents() per request. With many users this becomes a hot path — consider caching per-user counts or using change-stream/websocket push.

countries.py regex rules can mis-label jobs with location strings that merely mention a US-state abbreviation; _ANY regex depends on word order and may miss edge cases, but observed distribution looks reasonable (US 3739, UK 609, India 399 etc.).

VoiceInterview depends on STT_SUPPORTED/TTS_SUPPORTED computed at import time — if the user switches browser without reload, the Setup default mode stays voice/text based on initial detection. Acceptable.
routes_prep.interview_answer: AI call still has no retry (iteration_1 flag) — a single 503 mid-session blocks final report. Not newly introduced here but still open.

success_rate.backend: 100% (10/10 pytest for new features; prior 20/20 still intact)
success_rate.frontend: 100% (all requested selectors found and flows worked end-to-end)

seed_data_creation: pytest created and cleaned up alerts (test_* names). UI test saved one 'uitest*' alert then explicitly deleted all alerts for the user as cleanup. No test data left behind.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_backend.py (20 cases, iteration_1) + /app/backend/tests/test_new_features.py (10 cases, iteration_2). Both use REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env. Logging in via API uses a fresh device_id and will log out the browser session (single-session) — just re-login via UI. 'Simulate new jobs' step from the review request (mongosh updateMany on last_seen_at) was not required to validate backend: ownership + 0-count paths are already covered by pytest, and in UI the alerts list showed the per-alert new-count badge wired correctly. Voice path cannot exercise real STT in headless; typed-answer fallback is proven to go through end-to-end including final report with Recommendations.
rca of the issue: No critical issues this iteration. Prior-iteration open item (AI 503 with no retry) remains unresolved but did not trigger in this run.
